preconditions.description: Number of tournaments is between 1 and 50,000.
Number of kinds of sport is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sij <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(k))
preconditions.description: Power of each sportsman in each kind of sport is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(len(si) == k for si in powers)
preconditions.description: Each sportsman has exactly k powers corresponding to each kind of sport.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(si)) == k for si in powers)
preconditions.description: All powers of a sportsman in different kinds of sport are distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of possible winners for each tournament is equal to the number of tournaments.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= winner_count <= i + 1 for i, winner_count in enumerate(return_value, start=0))
postconditions.description: The number of possible winners for the i-th tournament is between 1 and i+1.
